event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Chips ripped, defensives sagged, oil sank.
Nov 6 payrolls printed +16.5k vs +6.5k fc with unemployment at 4.1% vs 4.2% fc, and that goldilocks read powered a semis-led melt-up two days later; today's tape was a violent high-to-low unwind inside tech rather than broad risk-on, with SPY +2.37% but NVDA -4.27% on 3.9x volume while AMD +13.26% and AMAT +11.37% absorbed the bid. Flows confirm real money moving: SPY +$9.4bn (92p) and SMH +$1.15bn (94p) against GLD -$351mm.

INDICES — VIX 19.9, down hard (VIXY -13.41%).
SOXX +7.49%, QQQ +3.54%, IWM +3.23%, SPY +2.37%, DIA +2.17%. Large > small by only 0.31pp — a narrow gap. Notable cross-asset: USO -3.87% vs UNG +7.81%. QQQ sits BELOW its 200-day MA — CTA sell trigger live.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY and QQQ vol_ratio 1.0x/1.0x (below the 1.18x index average); the volume was in SOXX 2.4x, IJH 1.8x, SCHH 3.5x. Vol up + price up in semis = accumulation; NVDA's 3.9x on -4.27% is the lone distribution print. Breadth: 410/90 advancers, 69% above 50DMA, 62% above 200DMA, up/down volume 2.73, 47 new highs vs 7 lows — participation confirms, broad not narrow.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLI Industrials +3.82%, XLK Technology +3.73%, XLY Discretionary +2.92%, XLC Comms +2.45%, XLB Materials +1.91%, XLV Healthcare +1.91%, XLU Utilities +1.53%, XLF Financials +1.45%, XLRE Real Estate +1.45%, XLP Staples +0.90%, XLE Energy +0.52%.
Top industries UNG +7.81% and SOXX +7.49%; bottom USO -3.87% and MSOS -4.01%. Flows contradict the leaders: XLV +$977mm (98p) and XLF +$816mm (90p) took the biggest 5d inflows while XLI bled -$435mm (8p) and XLC -$710mm (4p). Money is rotating into healthcare/financials, out of industrials and comms — leaders are being sold, so today's XLI pop is short-covering, not conviction. Label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY and QQQ PCR both 0.77 (mild complacency), skew +14.2%/+14.9% (put premium bid). SPY spot sits above the 751 GEX flip — dealers long gamma, moves dampened. VIXEQ 43.9 vs VIX 19.9 = wide dispersion gap; stock-picker's rotation tape, not macro-correlated.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -3.87% into rigs at 463 (up from 462) with dollar -0.55% is demand fear, not supply; silver +2.71% and gold +1.88% rallying with the dollar down is straight debasement bid. Next FOMC Dec 9: CME FedWatch prices hike 100.0%; Polymarket 80% for +25bp (5d +2pp) vs 18% no-change. Rate-path risk is one-sided hawkish.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 51.1, Neutral. AMD +13.26% on a Morgan Stanley price-target raise and lifted FY27 revenue/EPS; TER +12.73% on the Omnyx launch; NVDA -4.27% on 3.9x volume with heavy put activity. Momentum worst: XLK 20d -12.98%, XLE -6.17%. Watch SPY (gamma flip 751, spot near it), GLD (366 flip = max pain, -$351mm outflow), and SOXX (2.4x volume, 5d -67.65% shows the crash it's rebounding from).
